units.title: Observe both outcome signs on one current claimed-write payload
units.objective: Lazily extend the existing source pre-write adapter with a typed explicit-scenario observer, then retain would_allow and would_deny correlations for one byte-identical current Plan 116 payload without changing ordinary admission.

included: Strict typed outcome pre-write observation and append-only writer
Lazy explicit-scenario option in the existing source adapter
Default-path, target-binding, claim-precedence, and non-blocking focused tests
Active and recovery scenarios sharing one exact Plan 116 target
Current-claim same-payload manual replay and retained both-sign evidence
Plan 116 plan, graph, index, and roadmap reconciliation
excluded: Claim-schema mutation, outcome binder, or projection fields for outcome state
Durable lease storage or automatic progress classification
Hook wiring, native activation, installer, fleet, colleague, or external-user propagation
Outcome blocking, shell coverage, break glass, deployment, or release controls

outputs: Lazy opt-in source adapter correlation with unchanged default behavior
Active and recovery immutable Plan 116 scenarios
Two ordinary allow receipts correlated to would_allow and would_deny outcome effects
Revision-bound manual replay evidence and explicit promotion limits

acceptance.criterion: With no outcome option, the existing adapter follows its prior import, output, ordinary-receipt, and exit path and creates no outcome ledger.
evidence_required: Source adapter diff and ordinary decision assertion
acceptance.negative_control: Importing or running the default adapter does not require the outcome observer or Pydantic evaluator.

acceptance.criterion: The same current claimed-write payload retains ordinary allow in both runs and correlates would_allow active_in_scope and would_deny recovery_required observations to their exact ordinary receipts.
acceptance.negative_control: The recovery outcome cannot change the ordinary adapter decision or exit code.

acceptance.criterion: Target mismatch, scenario failure, and ordinary claim denial are visible without being mislabeled or applied as outcome enforcement.
acceptance.negative_control: An ordinary claim denial records not_evaluated_claim_denied rather than would_deny.

acceptance.criterion: Evidence is truthfully limited to manual source-adapter replay and licenses no claim mutation, native delivery, installer, shell, enforcement, colleague, or fleet claim.
acceptance.negative_control: No hook or installer file is in the unit conflict surface.

claim_policy.eligibility_rule: One exact live Plan 116 claim owns only the observer, existing adapter, focused test, two scenarios, evidence, plan, graph, index, and roadmap paths.
